sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko And 2 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Vijayendra Prakash Tripathi,Deepika,Vivek Kumar Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the
record.

2.  The present application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with the prayer to direct the learned court below to expedite and conclude the trial of Case No.476/2024, arising out of Case Crime No.42/2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., Police Station 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station - Mahila Thana, District Faizabad/Ayodhya.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has filed aforesaid case but same has not been decided by the court below and only general dates are being given, therefore,
indulgence of this Court is necessary to direct the court below for expeditious disposal of the aforesaid case.
Pratibha Sharma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko ...

entities.text: Pratibha Sharma vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. has no objection, in case, a direction for expeditious disposal of the case has been issued.
5. Considering the arguments of learned counsel for the parties and going through the records,
learned court below is directed to decide the case in question of the applicant, expeditiously, without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties, in accordance with the law.
6. With the aforesaid direction, the present application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. is disposed of.
